errors.what: patch-data with inline JSON arg failed (os error 123) — CLI treats arg as a file path
errors.recovered_by: checked --help, then piped JSON via stdin using '-'

problems_and_friction: patch-data takes a JSON file path (or stdin '-'), not an inline JSON string, so the first attempt failed; resolved via stdin. The CLI's next: hints repeatedly pushed pack-html to refresh the stale human view, but the protocol forbids it for a data-bound field.
context_understood: Changed the single data-bound field rollout_phase2_date from 2026-08-01 to 2026-09-15 via patch-data alone, relying on {{key}} binding to propagate without re-authoring HTML.
